title: Cr-Ni: one-shot to step-4 pick s1

snapshot.note: Frozen review snapshot of the step-4 pick (6 Nov 2026), for the Cr-Ni paper SI / Zenodo crate. The ZPF-sigma test reruns of step 4 are in progress and are not shown.

status_banner: Draft. Pick misses the CrNi2 window (top 780 K vs 863 K); step 4 used exclusions at a subset of states; ZPF-sigma tests of step 4 in progress.

pick.label: step 4 s1
pick.objective_name: log posterior (ESPEI log-likelihood + hinge + weak prior)

steps.data_added: liquid ZPF, eutectic, liquid S_ex, one-shot observations (CRNI2 not free)

steps.data_added: same data, CRNI2 free and anchored
